name: Chess Belle
source:
Age: Unknown

Chess is a seventeenth progenitor and one of [url=/c40806]Crowley's[/url] vampire servants. She is immature, careless, playful, and childish, which foils the more serious and mature behavior of her partner, Horn. She is very fond of both Crowley and Horn, and she can usually be found in their company. She gets jealous easily. She considers Horn to be stuffy. She has difficulty controlling her desire for blood, so she tends to kill the humans she drinks from.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Chess_Belle]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
